explanation.text:
:INNSIKT is a Norwegian association (forening/lag/innretning) dedicated to the rehabilitation of inmates in Norwegian prisons through teaching and reflective conversations, with the aim of reducing reoffending after release. The organization runs a program called «Frihet fra innsiden» (Freedom from the inside), which is approved by the Norwegian Correctional Service (KDI) and recommended by KRUS, the Norwegian Correctional Services college and education centre. The program focuses on uncovering unexplored potential within individuals rather than targeting undesirable behaviour, and is delivered in voluntary groups of about 10 participants, meeting for two hours per week over 10 weeks, with content adaptable to prison needs. It emphasizes mental wellbeing, renewed life perspective, reduced anxiety and anger, improved relationships, and a new understanding of personal reality and past experiences, all grounded in a value-neutral, non-religious approach that respects the individual and believes in their potential. Participants who benefit may later assist as group helpers with additional follow-up. The program draws inspiration from similar initiatives in prisons in the USA and UK. The association is based at c/o Else Belgau, Sønderhellene 10, 3404 Lier, Norway, and operates under company number 925833088. No employee count, CEO, or owner information is provided in the record.

explanation.text:
(HUB) HJELP UGANDAS BARN is a Norwegian association (Forening/lag/innretning) based in Risøyhamn, focused on operating children's homes, promoting self-help initiatives, collecting donations, and conducting malaria vaccinations. As of August 29, 2026, 2,847 people have received the malaria vaccine through HUB's vaccine project in Africa. The organization has been active in Kenya since summer 2024, where it purchased eight hectares of farmland for 24,000 USD to be paid over 24 months, supported the cultivation of food crops, financed water wells—including one at Sunhome Garden completed by September 13, 2024, in partnership with MAJI SAFI DRILLING COMPANY—and has supported malaria vaccination efforts, including a June 2024 initiative led by Pastor Jairo Akanga that vaccinated 106 people with no observed side effects after four months. HUB also supports the Victory Children Center, where, as of late June 2024, 36 children were sleeping at the center while others stayed with relatives, and where Christmas 2025 was celebrated with a sheep meat meal made possible by a HUB gift. By January 16, 2026, a new student home at the center was named 'Helle Home' in gratitude to Hellekirken in Norway. HUB considers its 'Help to Self-Help' project in Uganda completed after approximately 15 years of work and around three million Norwegian kroner in investments, achieving economic self-sufficiency. The organization continues to collaborate with a pastor couple in Kenya, Jairo Akanga and Sharon Jairo, to extend its work from Uganda to Kenya, including operating a children's home and promoting new malaria vaccines for Africa, while accepting donations for Kenya projects via Vipps marked 'Kenya'. Vegetables are being grown in the SUNHOME Garden for the children's home in Kenya, and well drilling is ongoing in the same area.

How to get to Tredalen?
It is easy to access Tredalen by public transportation. You can take the bus from Oslo bussterminal. Take a bus towards Skjærhalden. Exit the bus on the stop called Bekkene on the island Spjærøy. It is about 10-12 minutes to walk from the stop to the Tredalen’s main house.

explanation.text:
1. Tanum Speidergruppe is a scouting group under Asker og Bærum krets of Norges Speiderforbund, offering scouting activities for boys and girls from 1st grade. The group organizes regular meetings for different age groups, including Småspeidere on Tuesdays from 18:00–19:30 and Troppen on Tuesdays from 18:30–20:00, held at Tanum school and Kvikkhytta in Tanumskogen. In summer 2024, the group is arranging a camp at Vässarö scout island in Sweden starting Friday, 28 June. The group emphasizes play, experiences, community, and friendship in its meetings, where children learn skills through fun activities, sometimes including forest outings, campfires, singing, or storytelling, and can earn scout badges. It encourages volunteer leadership and notes that Rovers aged 16–25 are the oldest members, organized in their own Rover team, planning trips and activities while serving as role models for younger members and having opportunities to participate in local, national, and international events. The group ensures that competent, trustworthy adult leaders are always present with Beaver Scouts to support the development of responsibility and independence through community experiences. Many members choose to serve as leaders alongside their Rover work, though Rover scouting remains the core focus for this age group.

facts.evidence_text:
Beverkolonien er for speidere i 2.klasse, og består av barn med skoletilhørighet til Brønnerud, Rustad, Steinerskolen og Åsgård. Barn fra andre skoler er også velkommen. Vi møtes annenhver torsdag  kl. 18.00-19.00 ved speiderhuset Frydenhaug.

Vi starter opp med speiding for barn født i 2018 torsdag 4. september 2025.  Torsdag 18. september inviterer vi til foreldremøte for nye beverforeldre/foresatte.

Klikk her for innmelding.

Beverkolonien ledes av frivillige unge og voksne speiderledere. En beverleder har opplæring og godkjenning og er forsikret for å ta vare på tryggheten til beverne. Foreldre er alltid velkommen til å bli speiderledere om de ønsker, men det er ikke et krav. Beverne skal i utgangspunktet lære å klare seg selv og foreldre/foresatte er ikke til stede på møter eller turer om de ikke er med som hjelpeledere. Det forventes noe dugnadsarbeid fra foresatte i forbindelse med vedlikehold av speiderhuset og speiderhytta Trampen.

Ved spørsmål, ta kontakt med beverleder Kai Stian Smedsrud på e-post til kai.stian.smedsrud@speiding.no.

Informasjon om møter og turer legges i Spond-gruppen «1. Ås Beverkoloni».

Alle møter er ute, om ikke annet blir opplyst. Kle dere etter vær og føreforhold, og ta med hodelykt når det begynner å bli mørkt om kveldene.

Innhold og mål

På møtene er det lek, opplevelser, fellesskap og vennskap som gjelder. Beverne lærer nye ferdigheter først og fremst gjennom morsomme aktiviteter og oppgaver.

Målet med beverarbeidet er at barna skal få gode erfaringer med friluftsliv, oppleve vennskap og føle tilhørlighet til beverkolonien og til 1. Ås, slik at de får et positivt forhold til speideren før de senere går videre til flokk og tropp. Ved siden av enkel innføring i og erfaring med friluftslivets gleder, er lek og moro en viktig del av både turer og møter.

Det er alltid kompetente, trygge, voksne speiderledere sammen med beverspeiderne. Gjennom opplevelse av fellesskapet i beverkolonien starter den enkeltes utvikling av ansvarsfølelse og selvstendighet.

facts.value: 100-Meterskogen barnehage is a kindergarten located near Røyken sentrum, offering childcare with engaged, caring, and playful adults. The kindergarten provides horse visits twice a week where children can pet, groom, and take short rides, promoting respect, care, and social competence. It features a dedicated outdoor area with a gapahuk and obstacle course for play with natural materials like stones, sticks, leaves, and moss, encouraging imagination and creativity. The kindergarten emphasizes play using recycled and reused materials such as green boxes, milk corks, various packaging, bottles, textiles, metals, and planks. Staff actively engage with children on the floor to guide and support play and social interaction. Four- and five-year-olds are offered ski school annually with skilled instructors to experience ski play and mastery. Every other Friday, some Tigergutt children visit Bråset care and housing center for elderly residents to engage in activities and social interaction. The kindergarten holds an open day for visits on Wednesday, 3 February, from 15:00 to 18:00, with application deadline for main admission on 1 March. Planned days for 2026/2027 are Friday 11.09, Wednesday 23.12, Thursday 18.02, and Monday 24.05 and Tuesday 25.05. The kindergarten is closed for summer during the three middle weeks of July (weeks 27, 28, and 29), and children must have four weeks of holiday during the kindergarten year (August to August).
facts.evidence_text:
Vår barnehage finner du rett ved Røyken sentrum, med skogen og fotballbanen rett utenfor porten. Vi kan tilby engasjerte, omsorgsfulle og lekne voksne som er tilstede for ditt barn! Ta gjerne kontakt hvis det er noe du lurer på, eller om du ønsker plass til ditt barn hos oss.

Hos oss er vi så heldige at vi kan tilby hest for barna. Hestene kommer på besøk til oss to ganger i uken. Barna får leie, stelle, klappe og de som ønsker det får ta seg en liten ridetur. Vi ser tydelig verdien av å presentere dyr for barna. De lærer å ha respekt, ta vare på de rundt seg og ikke minst styrkes den sosiale kompetansen. Barna viser tydelig glede når hestene kommer og tar godt vare på dyra når de er på besøk. Hvordan barna forholder seg til hestene, kan overføres til hvordan de skal forholde seg til hverandre. Hvordan tar vi kontakt med voksne og barn rundt oss?

Barnehagen har et eget turområde med gapahuk og hinderløype. Her er det mye god lek med ulike naturmaterialer som befinner seg der; store steiner, pinner, blader, mose osv., for ikke å snakke om barnas egen fantasi. Vi beveger oss i ulendt og varierende terreng og leker i naturens små lekekroker. Hos oss går vi på både lange og korte turer, og barna blir på denne måten godt kjent i nærområdet vårt.

Annenhver fredag besøker noen av Tigerguttbarna Bråset bo-og omsorgssenter. Der får barna være i aktivitet og sosialt samvær med beboerne.

I 100-meterskogen barnehage har vi stort fokus på lek. Vi er bevisste på hva vi tilføyer leken av ulike materialer og har stort fokus på gjenbruk. I leken bruker vi ulike materialer som for eksempel grønne kasser, melkekorker, ulike emballasjer, flasker, ulike tekstiler, metaller og planker. Dette ser vi har stor verdi for leken og det skapes mye kreativ lek.  Vi legger til rette for at barna kan bruke sin fantasi i frilek. Vi voksne er sammen med barna på gulvet, veileder og er tilstede for de som trenger støtte eller et fang å sitte på. Barna skal lære seg ulike lekekoder og få gode strategier for å være i lek og sosialt samspill med hverandre.

Hvert år får 4- og 5- åringene tilbud om å delta på skiskole som arrangeres av barnas skiskole.  Her får barna oppleve skilek i regi av dyktige instruktører, og alle opplever mestringsfølelse!

VELKOMMEN TIL VÅR BARNEHAGE !

Vi vil sette spor

Åpen dag for besøk onsdag 3. februar kl. 15.00-18.00. Vurderer dere å søke plass hos oss i 100- meterskogen barnehage? Da vil vi gjerne få invitere dere på besøk, så dere får mulighet til å se hvordan vi har det hos oss. Passer det ikke denne dagen, er det bare å ta kontakt, så finner vi et annet tidspunkt. Frist for å søke barnehageplass til hovedopptaket er 1. mars.

“I won’t do it unless we’re one hundred percent dedicated to make it as sustainable as we possibly can” was another.
Everyone nodded along in agreement. But by the third answer the nodding stopped.
“But we can’t just make skis. Skiing has never been about skis. It’s about the culture. Our culture, the culture we grew up in. We owe it so much and we have to try and give back to it and keep it growing, evolving and stuff.”
The nodding stopped because it had turned into something else. A sort of headbanging. Violent, euphoric, f**k-yeah-that’s-right headbanging.

Epilogue

We didn't have a name that day, but that’s when the ski company 1000 was born. Or 1000 the culture company if you will. Because while we work harder then we’ve ever worked to make the skis we’ve always wanted to ski, the real reason we’re doing this is to take over an industry run by big corporations and give back the power to the ones who truly keep it alive. The skiers.
So, whenever there’s a decision to make there’s one thing that echoes in the back of our minds. A lodestar, a motto, a rule that helps us stay on the right track.

KEEP THE
CULTURE
MOVING .

Design

“That looks cool, I want that!” is probably one of the most common thoughts in the world. A new graphic every year can make people buy a new pair even if they don’t actually need one. Over-consumption is a driver of climate change and we don’t want any part in it. That’s why we make red skis and red skis only. New year? Same color. New model? Same color. It hurts sometimes, because of course we get so, so many ideas on graphics. But it’s a good pain. “Why red though?” you might wonder. Why not? It’s nice. It’s the color of love. And just like the skis it POPS

Manufacturing

Maybe you’ve been to Åre, maybe you’ve not. Either way, it’s probably the Swedish capital of skiing and definitely the place we make our skis. Åre Ski Factory has won awards for being themselves – a top-tier facility with more than 40 years of experience. As the young kid on the block we call the ski industry, we can’t stress enough how much it means to us to work with such an institution. We thought we knew skis and sustainability, but thanks to everyone at Åre Ski Factory we now know a lot more.

Social responsibility

There are so many ways to take responsibility, and we try our best to do it all. Both in the background and in the public eye. All of our tier 1 and 2 suppliers are based within the European Union, where EU law sets requirements for safe working conditions, fair wages, and adequate rest and leave. We’re also collaborating with the Winter Sports Network to map out the conditions further down the supply chain. As a bootstrapped company started by six white guys, we’re well aware of the journey that lies ahead of us – and the ski industry as a whole – to make our small part of the world a more diverse and inclusive place. Our first step is to support GRAB Collective & Solina Sessions, communities of female skiers that are doing awesome work to create a platform for more girls and women to excel in freeskiing. If you have (or know) of other projects that supports inclusivity in skiing, we’d love to hear about it.

Community

We’re founded by X-Games medalists, awarded ski film makers and long-time professional skiers. But that’s just a resume. We’re really founded by people who loves skiing. Not only the act of it, but everything around it. The people, the places, the fact that you can meet a stranger on a beach on the other side of the world and feel like friends just because you found out that you’re both skiers. It’s the culture we grew up in and we want to do everything we can to give back. We’re still in the starting blocks, but we invest in our riders, content creators, community events, films and other projects that we see creates value for the culture. And we ask you, our customers, to be a part of our journey and tell us where you think we should go as a brand.

Sustainability

Sustainability wasn’t really a subject in the 90’s or the 00’s, but we know a lot more these days. And the best thing about being a fairly new company is that we don’t have any old habits to get rid of. We can make it right from the beginning. We have signed the Race to Zero initiative through SME Climate Hub and set ourselves two goals: to halve our emissions intensity per ski produced by 2030, and to reach net zero by 2050. These are goals, not independently verified results; our Climate Action Plan describes how we work towards them. And since we're still a tiny player on a big field, we're thrilled to be part of the Winter Sports Network, a group that covers a large majority of the ski and snowboard industry. It's where we share best practices, unify our voice with suppliers, and do what we can to set an example for other industries.
‍
To learn more about our work follow #1000sustainability.
‍
For a more in-depth read our sustainability page >

Benefit for All

The "B" in B Corp stands for Benefit for All. Not just shareholders — workers, communities, customers, and the environment.As a certified B Corp ski brand, we've met rigorous standards for social and environmental impact. We've made a legal commitment to transparency and accountability.1000skis is one of few rider-owned ski companies to earn this certification. For us, it's not a badge. It's how we've operated since day one.

facts.value: 1423 World Class Spirits started as a hobby in the early 2008's. Back then a group of friends now and then enjoyed a dram of whisky. At a Danish whisky fair, the group of friends stumbled upon a man who wanted them to try rum rather than whisky. At first the guys declined but as the fair went on, they decided to give the rum a try. And what a game changing experience it turned out to be! There it was - the unique and fantastic universe of rum. It clearly affected the group of friends. After the fair the guys researched the rum universe, and they liked what they found. A short time after they bottled their first rum. A few hundred bottles of a Barbados-Trinidad blend, which was bottled November 2008 and released in the beginning of 2009. The sample number of the blend was marked as 1423 and thus the company name was found.

The success of selling bottles and their increased knowledge in rum distillation gave the group appetite for developing their own product. “Esclavo 12” was launched on the market in 2012 and is today part of the Patridom series. facts.value: Den nye nettsiden for 17. mai i Bergen er bygget for å fungere godt på mobil, med tydelige kort, store trykkflater og korte veier til viktig informasjon for bruk ute i byen.
facts.evidence_text: Den nye siden er laget for å fungere godt på mobil. Det er jo nettopp der du trenger den når du står på Torget, følger Flaggtoget eller prøver å finne neste opplevelse med familien. Tydelige kort, store trykkflater og korte veier til viktig informasjon gjør det lettere å bruke siden ute i byen.

facts.value: Nettsiden inneholder informasjon om fem prosesjoner: Morgenprosesjonen, Hovedprosesjonen, Flaggtoget, Kapproningsprosesjonen og Fakkeltoget, med detaljer om oppmøte, avgang og ruter.

facts.value: Den Kapproningsprosesjonen går fra Kaigaten etter Hovedprosesjonen, cirka kl. 12.30, til Dreggekaien og ledes av 17. mai-komiteen, Det glade Bergen, Alvøens Musikkforening og Sjøkrigsskolens kadetter.
facts.evidence_text: Den lille Kapproningsprosesjonen går fra Kaigaten etter Hovedprosesjonen, cirka kl. 12.30, til Dreggekaien med lagene som skal delta i kapproningen. Den ledes av 17. mai-komiteen, Det glade Bergen, Alvøens Musikkforening og Sjøkrigsskolens kadetter.

facts.value: Nettsiden har et interaktivt kart som lar brukere velge prosesjonsruter og zoome inn på byen, med foreløpige ruter merket og opplysninger som oppdateres når årets opplegg er bekreftet.
facts.evidence_text: Det interaktive kartet lar deg velge prosesjonsruter og zoome inn på byen. Du får oversikten hjemmefra og kan ta den med deg ut i gatene. Foreløpige ruter er merket, og opplysningene oppdateres når årets opplegg er bekreftet.

facts.value: Nettsiden gir informasjon om praktiske forhold som toaletter, transport til sentrum, tilrettelegging, førstehjelp og sitteplasser under Praktisk informasjon.
facts.evidence_text: Hvor finner du toaletter? Hvordan kommer du deg til sentrum? Trenger du tilrettelegging, førstehjelp eller en sitteplass? Under Praktisk informasjon er hjelpen samlet og delt inn i temaer som er enkle å finne.

facts.value: Lag, foreninger og andre deltakere kan finne veien til påmelding til prosesjonene, søknad om kjøretøytillatelse og informasjon om bodplasser under Delta-seksjonen på nettsiden.
facts.evidence_text: Under Delta finner lag, foreninger og andre deltakere veien til påmelding til prosesjonene, søknad om kjøretøytillatelse og informasjon om bodplasser.

facts.value: Nettsiden tilbyr besøksinformasjon på engelsk for å gjøre nasjonaldagen tilgjengelig for flere.
facts.evidence_text: Vi har også samlet besøksinformasjon på engelsk , slik at flere kan forstå og oppleve vår helt særegne nasjonaldag.

facts.value: Den nye nettsiden inneholder en historisk tidslinje fra 1814 til i dag med 20 historiske stopp, inkludert Grunnloven, de første saluttene, Flaggtoget, Bjørnson, Vikingskipet og frigjøringsfeiringen i 1945.
facts.evidence_text: 20 historiske stopp tar deg fra Grunnloven og de første saluttene til Flaggtoget, Bjørnson, Vikingskipet og frigjøringsfeiringen i 1945. Stoppene har lenker videre til historieartikler og årets bilder.

facts.value: Nettsiden har et bilde- og videoarkiv med ekte fotografier fra Bergen og et talearkiv med taler og seremonier samlet etter år.
facts.evidence_text: I bilde- og videoarkivet kan du gjenoppleve stemningen, og i talearkivet finner du taler og seremonier samlet etter år.

facts.value: Nettsiden fremhever bedrifter og organisasjoner som bidrar gjennom Sammen for Bergen, og gir frivillige, deltakere og støttespillere synlighet.
facts.evidence_text: Vi løfter også frem bedriftene og organisasjonene som bidrar gjennom Sammen for Bergen . Bak folkefesten står et stort fellesskap av frivillige, deltakere og støttespillere. Den nye nettsiden gir dem den synligheten de fortjener.

explanation.text:
2 SNØMENN AS is an Aksjeselskap (private limited company) registered in Norway with company number 992357010, located at Holteveien 36, 1410 KOLBOTN. The company operates in the industry of cooling systems, heat pump work, and installation of stoves, providing cooling services to private clients, the cooling industry, the food industry, and other businesses. Founded in 2008 and based in Kolbotn just outside Oslo, 2 SNØMENN AS serves customers across the Oslo region and from Tønsberg to Toten, offering consulting, design, installation, and service for cooling rooms, cooling systems, heat pumps, air conditioning, and ventilation, with a focus on operational reliability and 24-hour emergency support. The company and all its employees hold F-Gas certification at the highest level (class 1), and it is approved as an apprenticeship training company. Financial data shows revenue of 18,186,114 NOK in 2025, 13,482,651 NOK in 2024, and 12,146,693 NOK in 2023, with corresponding net results of 5,044,893 NOK, 4,188,254 NOK, and 3,572,456 NOK, and total assets of 8,917,504 NOK, 8,338,455 NOK, and 8,316,302 NOK respectively. The company’s products and services include cooling and freezing, ice water and pumps, heat pumps, process systems, retail, air conditioning, data centers, ventilation, consulting, and service agreements.

2. Sandnes SjØspeidergruppe av NSF is a Sea Scout group based in Sandnes, Norway, operating as a forening/lag/innretning under the Norwegian Guide and Scout Association. Founded in 1958, the group has approximately 200 members aged 6 to 25 and is among the largest Sea Scout groups in the country. The organization conducts regular scouting activities, specialized training in seamanship and water safety, and runs a summer school for children aged 8–12 to introduce them to maritime life. It maintains a fleet of around 40 boats, including dinghies, small overnight-capable sailboats, and the large sailboat S/Y Nordsjø, all used during the sailing season from Easter to after autumn holidays. All activities are volunteer-driven, with leaders, parents, and Scouts contributing thousands of hours annually to maintenance and operations, following the Scout method with principles such as learning by doing, patrol system use, and progressive skill development. The group’s home harbor is located at the old Sandnes Sea Bath innermost in Gandsfjord, just outside the town center, and includes a clubhouse, harbor, slip, boathouse, and activity area with a gapahuk. Recent activities have included Easter voyages for Scouts aged 13–25 (up to 30 participants, lasting 8–9 days to Florø), weekend trips, Pentecost camps on Forøy in Ryfylke, summer camps, and participation in national and international events such as the 2022 Sea Scout Camp (Sandnes–Inner Oslofjord–Sandnes), the 2017 National Scout Camp (Sandnes–Bodø–Sandnes), and the 2011 World Jamboree (Sandnes–Kristiansand–Copenhagen–Kristianstad–Sandnes). The group actively seeks adult volunteers to lead youth activities, emphasizing inclusivity and shared responsibility for youth development in the local community. Financial data shows revenue of 1,076,532 NOK in 2019, 1,325,903 NOK in 2018, and 1,398,807 NOK in 2017, with corresponding net results of 7,905 NOK, 145,697 NOK, and -254,867 NOK, and total assets of 1,622,514 NOK, 1,621,644 NOK, and 1,482,378 NOK respectively. The CEO is Aage Aagesen Leiros. The company number is 975484548. The industry is listed as "Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers" and the business description is "Sjøspeidergruppe". The address is Daleveien 110, 4328 SANDNES, Norge. Employee count is not available. Owner name is not available.

2Care Hjemmetjenester AS is a Norwegian limited liability company (Aksjeselskap) that has provided home care and practical assistance since 2006, originally operating under the name Unicare Hjemmetjenester. The company delivers quality-based home nursing care, stationary services, and practical assistance in Oslo and Lillestrøm, and is an approved provider of practical assistance (home help) for Oslo Municipality. It employs 526 people and is led by CEO Henriette Marie Hansson Nilssen, with its headquarters located at Brobekkveien 80, 0582 Oslo, Norway. In 2025, the company reported revenue of 175,303,280 NOK, a net result of 3,344,193 NOK, and total assets of 47,842,899 NOK. 2Care Hjemmetjenester is also certified as an Environmental Lighthouse (Miljøfyrtårn) and has partnered with God Matlyst to deliver weekly freshly prepared meals to elderly customers. The company offers a range of services including physiotherapy, social companionship, meal assistance, personal hygiene support, respite for relatives, and end-of-life care, and promotes private services through seasonal campaigns offering up to five free hours. It emphasizes continuity of care, with fixed staff assigned to clients in stationary services, overseen by a dedicated coordinator and responsible nurse.
